Game Overview

At its heart, Winter CosmoFest is a anime game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Winter CosmoFest doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Winter CosmoFest?

Winter CosmoFest is a free anime game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Winter CosmoFest free to play?

Yes, Winter CosmoFest is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
